title: Pasulka's Encounters source: daughter of a man thought to be in a secret space program who kept saying 'simulacra'

tellings.quote: Pasulka's source in her new book Encounters was the daughter of somebody who she thought was in a secret space program. One thing that will always give me the chills from that account is that her father would constantly refer to the word simulacra at lunch tables with his colleagues.

plain: Michels says that a source in Encounters, the 2023 book by the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, was the daughter of a man Pasulka believed worked in a secret space program, a hidden space effort some think the government runs. According to the daughter, her father would keep using the word "simulacra", meaning copies or imitations, at lunch tables with his colleagues. Michels says the detail still gives him chills and raises it in an episode about the idea that we live in a hologram.
